criteria: The exact minimum CdkTableModule public root export supplies the same four outlet directive objects through its existing exports. Full authenticated declaration and runtime module metadata agree for every export. Remove four unused bindings from table.ts (identical whole diagnostic JavaScript emit) and four redundant explicit imports from the legacy NgModule; its existing public CdkTableModule import preserves the template directive scope. No outlet replacement, template/selector/provider/style or CDK implementation change is made. This closes only these eight removed direct imports; other private boundaries and table/manual-constructor/native/packed contracts remain open.

reviews.decision: The frozen HeaderRowOutlet occurrence at legacy-table/table.ts is removed from the maintained source. The source never referenced this imported class outside its unused import; complete emitted component JavaScript is unchanged after all four unused outlet imports are removed. No selector, template, provider, table parent, row/outlet implementation or style behavior changes. The public module retains the outlet directive scope on both actual minimum versions. Close this obsolete direct private binding only; runtime/template/AOT/packed and all other table/DI/manual-constructor obligations remain separate.
